session:
version: 0.3.11
name: kbs-operator
predecessor: null
images:
- name: kbs_image
  injection_files:
  - path: /etc/kbs-config.toml
    content: |
      [http_server]
      sockets = ["0.0.0.0:8080"]
      private_key = "/etc/kbs/tls/tls.key"
      certificate = "/etc/kbs/tls/tls.crt"

      [admin]
      auth_public_key = "/etc/kbs/admin/public-key.pem"

      [policy_engine]
      policy_path = "/opt/confidential-containers/attestation-service/policies/opa/resource-policy.rego"

      [attestation_token]
      insecure_key = true

      [attestation_service]
      type = "coco_as_builtin"

      [attestation_service.attestation_token_broker]
      type = "Ear"

      [attestation_service.attestation_token_broker.signer]
      key_path = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/kbs-ec-key.pem"
      cert_path = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/kbs-cert-chain.pem"

      [[plugins]]
      name = "resource"
      type = "LocalFs"
      dir_path = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/repository"
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/attestation-service/policies/opa/resource-policy.rego
    content: |
      package policy

      default allow = false
  - path: /etc/kbs/tls/tls.key
    content: $$SCONE::kbs_tls_key$$
  - path: /etc/kbs/tls/tls.crt
    content: $$SCONE::kbs_tls_cert:crt$$
  - path: /etc/kbs/admin/public-key.pem
    content: |
      -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
      MCowBQYDK2VwAyEAYCicaAqZsAign7ZQ+SxpOfEBu+yrpXMLHfExOxKnrZ8=
      -----END PUBLIC KEY-----
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/kbs/kbs-ec-key.pem
    content: $$SCONE::kbs_private_key$$
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/kbs/kbs-cert-chain.pem
    content: |-
      $$SCONE::kbs_cert:crt$$
      $$SCONE::kbs_ca:crt$$
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/kbs/ca-cert.pem
    content: $$SCONE::kbs_ca:crt$$
secrets:
- name: kbs_ca_key
  kind: private-key
- name: kbs_ca
  kind: x509-ca
  private_key: kbs_ca_key
  common_name: SCONE KBS e2e CA
- name: kbs_private_key
  kind: private-key
  key_type: P-256
- name: kbs_cert
  kind: x509
  private_key: kbs_private_key
  common_name: SCONE KBS token signer
  issuer: kbs_ca
- name: kbs_tls_key
  kind: private-key
- name: kbs_tls_cert
  kind: x509
  private_key: kbs_tls_key
  common_name: kbs-operator-kbs.kbs-attested.svc
  issuer: kbs_ca
  endpoint: server
  san:
  - dns:kbs-operator-kbs.kbs-attested.svc
services:
- name: kbs
  image_name: kbs_image
  environment:
    RUST_LOG: debug
  command: /usr/local/bin/kbs --config-file /etc/kbs-config.toml
  pwd: /
  persistency: None
  attestation:
  - mrenclave:
    - 740159c37e751ba24321c7d2f8e3f060f6f707b704ca4c42bde3cbaf5258a754
    - 1857edcc29a4f70d2708e91d747a2b10422c65185e83d1be90989e420014d15f
access_policy:
  read:
  - ANY
  update:
  - ANY
security:
  attestation:
    mode: hardware
    tolerate:
    - debug-mode
    - hyperthreading
    - insecure-igpu
    - outdated-tcb
    - software-hardening-needed
    - insecure-configuration
    - aepic-leak
    ignore_advisories: '*'
creator: null
